Photorealistic straight-on night elevation of a modern Chinese department store main entrance, wide panoramic framing. Five tall framed glass doors with slim brushed stainless mullions and thick vertical handles. Through rain-speckled glass: a warm amber marble lobby, low reception desk, escalator rising at left, recessed ceiling downlights, polished stone floor with soft warm reflections. Interior colour is strictly warm amber and neutral greige, no green light strips, no potted plants, no neon signage, no coloured LEDs. Wet stone pavement in front catches a faint warm sheen. Rain droplets cling to the glass. Neutral dark exterior stone columns between the door bays. Architectural photography, straight horizontal verticals, high detail, realistic materials, balanced exposure, no people, no text, no watermark.
